TechNova Solutions - Junior Full Stack Developer Intern

About the Role:
TechNova Solutions is seeking an enthusiastic Junior Full Stack Developer Intern to contribute to our next-generation web applications.

Required Skills:
- JavaScript
- React
- Node.js
- MongoDB
- REST APIs

Preferred Skills:
- Docker
- AWS

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop RESTful APIs using Node.js and integrate with client-facing frontend applications.
- Build responsive, modern web interfaces and reusable components using React and JavaScript.
- Design and optimize NoSQL database schemas and aggregation queries in MongoDB.
- Participate in Agile sprints, code reviews, and cross-functional feature planning.
- Deploy containerized microservices and configure basic cloud infrastructure on AWS.
